business_summary: Lexeo Therapeutics, Inc., a clinical stage genetic medicine company, focuses on hereditary and acquired diseases with high unmet need in the United States. Its product pipeline comprises LX2006, an AAVrh10-based gene therapy candidate, which is in phase 1/2 clinical trial to treat friedreich ataxia cardiomyopathy; LX2020, an AAVrh10-based gene therapy candidate, which is in phase 1/2 to deliver a functional plakophilin-2 (PKP2) gene to cardiac muscle for the treatment of PKP2-ACM; and LX2021, a gene therapy candidate, which is in preclinical trial to deliver the coding sequence for the functional connexin 43, or Cx43, protein for a group of inherited cardiac muscle disorders associated with a high risk of sudden death, including arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy (ACM) and certain forms of dilated cardiomyopathy. The company is also developing LX2022, a gene therapy candidate, which is in preclinical trial to deliver a functional TNNI3 gene to myocardial cells to treat a distinct form of hypertrophic cardiomyopathy. In addition, it is developing LX1001, LX1020, and LX1021, an AAVrh10-based gene therapy candidate, which has completed phase 1/2 clinical trial for the treatment of APOE4-associated Alzheimer's disease. The company has a license agreement with Cornell University to conduct the Phase 1/2 clinical trial of LX1001, as well as support the development of the LX1004 program; a research collaboration agreement with Cornell University to conduct preclinical research to develop the licensed technology; and third license agreement which obtained certain rights for FA cardiomyopathy, including rights to current and future clinical data from an ongoing Cornell University investigator-initiated Phase 1A trial of a gene therapy candidate. The company was founded in 2017 and is headquartered in New York, New York.
business_summary_ko: 임상 단계 유전 의학 회사인 Lexeo Therapeutics, Inc.는 미국에서 충족되지 않은 수요가 높은 유전성 및 후천성 질환에 중점을 두고 있습니다. 제품 파이프라인은 AAVrh10 기반 유전자 치료 후보인 LX2006으로 구성되며 프리드라이히 운동실조증 심근병증 치료를 위한 1/2상 임상 시험이 진행 중입니다. AAVrh10 기반 유전자치료제 후보인 LX2020은 PKP2-ACM 치료를 위해 기능성 플라코필린-2(PKP2) 유전자를 심장 근육에 전달하는 임상 1/2상을 진행 중이다. 및 부정맥성 심근병증(ACM) 및 특정 형태의 확장성 심근병증을 포함하여 돌연사 위험이 높은 유전성 심근 장애 그룹에 기능성 코넥신 43 또는 Cx43 단백질의 코딩 서열을 전달하기 위한 전임상 시험 중인 유전자 치료법 후보인 LX2021이 있습니다. 이 회사는 또한 독특한 형태의 비대성 심근병증을 치료하기 위해 기능성 TNNI3 유전자를 심근 세포에 전달하기 위한 전임상 시험 중인 유전자 치료 후보인 LX2022를 개발하고 있습니다. 또한 LX1001, LX1020, AAVrh10 기반 유전자치료제 후보물질인 LX1021을 개발 중이며, APOE4-as 치료를 위한 1/2상 임상시험을 완료했다.
